title: opovi.json
description: The file at the root of a world's folder on the person's PC. Opowi writes it when the person saves the world's harness from the Agent connection panel; every fetch command reads it before any call. A newer Opowi may add fields, and a command ignores a field it does not know.

serverUrl.description: The address of the Opowi install the world lives on, with no trailing slash.

worldId.description: The world's id: a lowercase UUID version 7.

vendor.description: The agent the folder was saved for, which decides where its skills sit: .claude/skills for claude-code, .agents/skills for codex and antigravity.

harnessVersion.description: The number of the world's harness version the folder holds, 0 for a world with none. claim takes it, and refuses a version that is not the world's current one with ai-handoff.harness-stale.

skills.description: The names of the skills the folder holds, each a folder under the vendor's skills directory with a SKILL.md.
